office_does: The Auditor records documents, accounts for county spending, licenses vehicles, issues marriage licenses and runs voter registration and elections in Okanogan County.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Auditor Cari L Hall (Prefers Republican Party), elected in 2018 and 2022, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Okanogan County Auditor since 2019 and a Certified Elections Administrator, formerly the office's finance manager; the only candidate.
highlights: Elected Auditor in 2018 and 2022; finance manager in the office from 2015 [S1]
Cites cameras with a public live feed in the ballot-processing room and online recorded documents [S1]
